title: Grief and Comfort
definition: Grief and comfort addresses the sorrow of loss and the faithful comfort God gives to those who mourn.
summary: Grief is not a lack of faith. Scripture gives language for sorrow while pointing believers to God's presence, promises, resurrection hope, and compassionate care.
christFocus: Christ entered human sorrow, wept at the grave, and gives resurrection hope to His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Grief is not a lack of faith. Scripture gives language for sorrow while pointing believers to God's presence, promises, resurrection hope, and compassionate care.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
